<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Movimientos recurrentes</h1><div class="tf-muted">Facturas, suscripciones e ingresos programados; se confirman antes de contabilizarse.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>

  <button id="rec-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo recurrente</button>

</div>
<div id="rec-editor" class="tf-card" hidden><h2 id="rec-editor-title">Nuevo recurrente</h2><form id="rec-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre</label><input id="rec-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="rec-type"><option value="expense">Egreso</option><option value="income">Ingreso</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto estimado ($)</label><input id="rec-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta habitual (opcional)</label><select id="rec-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Categoría</label><select id="rec-category"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Subcategoría</label><select id="rec-subcategory"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Día del mes</label><input id="rec-day" type="number" min="1" max="31" value="1"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Recordar (días antes)</label><input id="rec-reminder" type="number" min="0" max="30" value="3"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Desde</label><input id="rec-start" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Hasta (opcional)</label><input id="rec-end" type="date"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button id="rec-submit" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar recurrente</button><button id="rec-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Cancelar edición</button></div></form></div><section id="mig006-panel" class="tf-card" hidden style="margin:0 0 1rem">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Bloque 6 de 11 · MIG-006</div><h2>Recurrente Quincena 2</h2><div class="tf-muted">La ocurrencia 2026-10 difiere de su plantilla en cuenta y clasificación. La decisión es manual porque alinear la cuenta modifica saldos históricos.</div></div></div>
  <div id="mig006-status" class="tf-alert tf-alert-info is-visible"></div>

  <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.9rem">

    <button id="mig006-align" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Alinear con plantilla</button>
  </div>
</section>
